action.script:
set -u input_mode="clipboard" input_path="" note_title="剪贴板记录" if (( ${NOTCH_COUNT:-0} > 0 )) && [[ -n "${NOTCH_FILE:-}" ]]; then input_mode="file" input_path="$NOTCH_FILE" note_title="${input_path##*/}" if [[ ! -f "$input_path" ]]; then print -u2 -- "只能读取单个普通文本文件：$input_path" exit 1 fi fi work_dir=$(mktemp -d "${NOTCH_TEMP_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/notes-XXXXXX") || exit 1 trap 'rm -rf -- "$work_dir"' EXIT snapshot="$work_dir/content.txt" error_file="$work_dir/error.txt" osascript_bin="${NOTCH_OSASCRIPT_BIN:-/usr/bin/osascript}" cat > "$work_dir/notes.applescript" <<'APPLESCRIPT' on replaceText(findText, replacementText, sourceText) set previousDelimiters to AppleScript's text item delimiters set AppleScript's text item delimiters to findText set sourceParts to every text item of sourceText set AppleScript's text item delimiters to replacementText set replacedText to sourceParts as text set AppleScript's text item delimiters to previousDelimiters return replacedText end replaceText on htmlEscape(sourceText) set normalizedText to my replaceText(return & linefeed, linefeed, sourceText) set normalizedText to my replaceText(return, linefeed, normalizedText) set escapedText to my replaceText("&", "&", normalizedText) set escapedText to my replaceText("<", "<", escapedText) set escapedText to my replaceText(">", ">", escapedText) return my replaceText(linefeed, "
", escapedText) end htmlEscape on readTextFile(inputPath) set inputFile to POSIX file inputPath try return read inputFile as «class utf8» on error try return read inputFile as Unicode text on error return read inputFile end try end try end readTextFile on run argv set phase to item 1 of argv set inputMode to item 2 of argv set inputPath to item 3 of argv set noteTitle to item 4 of argv set snapshotPath to item 5 of argv if phase is "snapshot" then if inputMode is "file" then set sourceText to my readTextFile(inputPath) else try set sourceText to the clipboard as text on error return "__EMPTY__" end try end if if sourceText is "" then return "__EMPTY__" set snapshotFile to open for access (POSIX file snapshotPath) with write permission try set eof snapshotFile to 0 write sourceText to snapshotFile as «class utf8» close access snapshotFile on error messageText number errorNumber close access snapshotFile error messageText number errorNumber end try return "__READY__" end if if phase is not "write" then error "未知执行阶段" set sourceText to my readTextFile(snapshotPath) if sourceText is "" then return "__EMPTY__" set titleHTML to my htmlEscape(noteTitle) set bodyHTML to my htmlEscape(sourceText) set noteHTML to "
" & titleHTML & "

" & bodyHTML & "
" tell application "Notes" set targetFolder to default folder of default account make new note at targetFolder with properties {name:noteTitle, body:noteHTML} end tell return "__CREATED__:" & noteTitle end run APPLESCRIPT run_phase() { "$osascript_bin" "$work_dir/notes.applescript" "$1" "$input_mode" "$input_path" "$note_title" "$snapshot" 2>"$error_file" } fail_phase() { local error_text="$(<"$error_file")" if [[ "$error_text" == *"-1743"* || "$error_text" == *"Not authorized to send Apple events"* || "$error_text" == *"不允许发送 Apple 事件"* ]]; then print -u2 -- "需要自动化权限：请前往“系统设置 > 隐私与安全性 > 自动化”，允许 NotchAny 控制“备忘录”，然后重试。" else print -u2 -- "${error_text:-写入备忘录失败。}" fi exit 1 } result=$(run_phase snapshot) || fail_phase if [[ "$result" == "__EMPTY__" ]]; then notch_result --summary "没有可写入的文本" --details "请先复制一段文本，或拖入一个文本文件。" exit 0 fi if [[ "$result" != "__READY__" ]]; then print -u2 -- "未能读取待写入的文本。" exit 1 fi if [[ "$input_mode" == "clipboard" ]]; then # 预览和写入复用同一快照，等待确认时不再读取剪贴板。 request=$(/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript - "$snapshot" <<'JXA' ObjC.import('Foundation'); function run(argv) { const text = ObjC.unwrap($.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(argv[0], $.NSUTF8StringEncoding, null)); if (typeof text !== 'string') throw new Error('无法读取文本快照'); const preview = Array.from(text).slice(0,1200).join('') + (Array.from(text).length > 1200 ? '\n\n（内容较长，仅预览前 1200 个字符）' : ''); return JSON.stringify({kind:'confirm', title:'写入备忘录', message:'剪贴板最近一条文本：\n\n'+preview, submit_label:'写入备忘录', cancel_label:'取消', timeout_seconds:120}); } JXA ) || exit 1 reply=$(notch_interact "$request") || exit 1 approved=$(/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript - "$reply" <<'JXA' function run(argv) { const reply = JSON.parse(argv[0]); const response = reply && reply.response; if (reply.ok !== true || !response || !['submitted','cancelled','timed_out'].includes(response.status)) throw new Error('未能完成写入确认，未写入备忘录'); return response.status === 'submitted' && response.confirmed === true ? 'yes' : 'no'; } JXA ) || exit 1 if [[ "$approved" != "yes" ]]; then notch_result --summary "已取消，未写入备忘录" exit 0 fi fi result=$(run_phase write) || fail_phase case "$result" in "__CREATED__:"*) notch_result --summary "已写入备忘录" --details "${result#__CREATED__:}" ;; "__EMPTY__") notch_result --summary "没有可写入的文本" ;; *) print -u2 -- "写入备忘录后收到未知结果：$result"; exit 1 ;; esac
